description: Notification hub utility. Centralises all outbound notifications. send_alert(subject,body,severity=HIGH)->bool: tries api.zo.computer/zo/notify with 8s timeout, falls back to writing ALERT_QUEUE.md. send_build_failure(task,description,reason)->bool: formats failure notification for Claude chat ingestion. send_daily_digest(content)->bool. notify_high_risk(server_name,verdict,trust_score)->bool. All methods: best-effort, never raise exceptions, always return bool success. Tracks send_count and failure_count. No daemon.
